d:
How do airplanes fly? In this video, we explain how airplanes work in simple words — from the four forces of flight (lift, thrust, drag, and weight) to airfoil wing design, jet engines, and Newton's third law of motion. Learn how airplane wings generate lift, how jet engines create thrust, and why drag is the enemy of every pilot.
Whether you're a student, an aviation enthusiast, or just curious about how a 500,000 kg metal machine stays in the sky, this beginner-friendly animated explainer breaks it all down.
